mission.title: Mission
mission.description: NetComplex is not a management tool. It's a platform designed to connect neighbors, streamline community operations, and enhance the quality of life in residential complexes. We believe that a truly connected community empowers residents, simplifies administration, and creates lasting relationships.
mission.coreBelief: A neighbourhood is not just an address — it's a living ecosystem of people, relationships, and shared experiences. We built NetComplex to strengthen these bonds through intelligent design and seamless technology.

features.title: Build a Connected Community
features.subtitle: Powerful tools that transform residential communities from managed populations into informed, engaged, and self-expressive networks.

list.title: Residents Directory
list.desc: Know who lives nearby. A trusted, public opt-in listing of your community.
list.details: Create your profile with photo, contact preferences, and interests. Browse by building or section. Privacy controls ensure you share only what you want.

list.title: Maintenance Requests
list.desc: Log it, track it, resolve it. From leaky faucets to community repairs.
list.details: Submit photos and descriptions. Track status updates in real-time. Communicate directly with maintenance staff. Rate service quality and resolution time.

list.title: Facility Bookings
list.desc: Book amenities with ease. Swimming pools, clubhouses, tennis courts.
list.details: View availability in real-time. Set recurring bookings. Receive automatic reminders. Cancel or reschedule with ease. Integrated calendar sync.

list.title: Community Content
list.desc: Your space to post updates, stories, and announcements.
list.details: Rich text editor with photos and videos. Categorize content for easy discovery. Comment and react to posts. Moderate with community guidelines.

list.title: Surveys & Polling
list.desc: Ask your community. Get real answers. Quick questions, instant sentiment.
list.details: Create multiple choice, rating, and open-ended questions. Anonymous or named responses. Real-time results visualization. Export data for analysis.

list.title: Affinity Groups
list.desc: Find your people within your complex. Connect over shared interests.
list.details: Create and join groups around interests. Private or public group settings. Event scheduling within groups. Member directories and messaging.

list.title: Community Events
list.desc: Discover and organize events that bring your community together.
list.details: Create events with RSVP tracking. Send automated reminders. Sell tickets or collect fees. Photo sharing after events. Recurring event schedules.

list.title: Web3 Digital Identity
list.desc: Build decentralized community governance and digital identities.
list.details: Token-based voting systems. Community treasury management. NFT memberships. Decentralized identity verification. Smart contract automation.

list.title: Localization
list.desc: Automate localization for your chosen language groups.
list.details: Translate content, notifications, and interfaces into multiple languages automatically.

list.title: Agent Gateway
list.desc: Connect human and machine agents to community systems.
list.details: Professional contact, Managed support, AI-powered customer service. Automated maintenance triage. Smart home integration. Voice-activated assistance.

list.title: Marketplace
list.desc: Buy and sell goods and services within your community.
list.details: Local marketplace for residents. Secure payment processing. Review and rating system. Direct messaging between buyers and sellers.

list.title: Education
list.desc: Access educational resources and learning opportunities.
list.details: Bursary Portal, Online courses and tutorials. Community learning events. Resource sharing. Peer-to-peer tutoring. Educational content library.

about.title: About NetComplex
about.subtitle: A community informatics platform built to connect neighbours, streamline operations, and enhance life in residential communities.
about.storyP1: NetComplex was born from a simple observation: residential communities were being managed with spreadsheets, email notices, and disjointed, social-media tools. Residents had no central place to connect, communicate, or collaborate.
about.storyP2: We built NetComplex to change that. What started as a solution for a single community in Cape Town has grown into a platform that serves residential complexes of all sizes across South Africa and the World.
about.storyP3: Today, NetComplex powers communities with tools for communication, maintenance, bookings, events, and governance — all in one place. We're on a mission to make every complex a connected community.
about.value1Desc: Every feature we build starts with the same question: does this empower households, liberate your neighbours and bring communities together?
about.value2Desc: Powerful tools don't have to be complicated. We design for clarity and responsiveness so every resident can participate. Choose your modules, embrace your customisations.
about.value3Desc: Built in South Africa for diverse African communities. We understand the unique linguistic dynamics of residential living on our continent and beyond.
about.builtByDesc: Netbones Africa is a South African technology company focused on community informatics. We believe that technology should bring people together, not push them apart. Our team is passionate about building tools that make residential living better for everyone — residents, management, and staff alike.
